name: Cr, Chromium, AFM BCC (CsCl-arrangement) 3D (Bulk), constructed from mp-90

metadata.note: 2-atom simple-cubic cell representing the antiferromagnetic (CsCl-type) sublattice ordering of BCC Cr: 'Cr1' and 'Cr2' are the same element on the two opposite-spin BCC sublattices (corner + body-center of the conventional BCC cell), distinguished only for per-species starting_magnetization. Lattice constant a=2.8845 Angstrom is the standard experimental BCC Cr lattice constant (same value as the conventional BCC cell edge; not independently relaxed for this AFM cell).
